summary: Exact candidate 19b9f743 independently verifies as a valid partial fix for the standard grpc.health.v1 portion: a rebuilt native library implements Check and Watch, suppresses duplicate unchanged NOT_SERVING events, keeps unknown-service Watch open with SERVICE_UNKNOWN, and passes its focused Rust and grpcio regression tests. It does not fully resolve upstream issue 38075 because native gRPC image/audio/video support, aggregated and encoder-disaggregated multimodal coverage, and explicit RL pause/drain, weight-update, ready-to-serve, and resume lifecycle semantics are absent from the candidate diff and remain unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Fresh optimized native build of the recorded base source; artifact path was /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f2399b3900a4/base-target/release/libsglang_grpc_core.so.
Original failure reproduced on the recorded base: standard Health/Check, Watch, and unknown-service Watch all returned UNIMPLEMENTED.
All 16 Rust tests passed, including unchanged-status suppression and late service registration state-machine tests.
Fresh optimized native candidate build; subsequent live tests explicitly loaded /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f2399b3900a4/candidate-target/release/libsglang_grpc_core.so.

Independent live grpcio adversarial probe with engine health fixed false: Check and first Watch returned NOT_SERVING (wire value 2); no unchanged second event arrived before a 2.4-second deadline; unknown Watch returned SERVICE_UNKNOWN (wire value 3) and remained open until its 2.4-second deadline.
Candidate regression and bridge compatibility suite passed: 7 tests and 2 subtests, with the printed preloaded native path confirming the rebuilt candidate library rather than a wheel artifact.

tests.command: git diff --name-only 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365..19b9f743bf6d251f666f43cc6c165a7d375b3efd; inspect proto/sglang/runtime/v1/sglang.proto and rust/sglang-grpc request conversion paths
tests.what_was_measured: Contract audit: candidate production changes are limited to the Rust health server and dependency lockfiles. No proto or implementation changes add native image/audio/video inputs, encoder-disaggregated multimodal behavior, RL operations, drain state, ready-to-serve state, or a defined pause/update/resume lifecycle.

gpu_evidence: No GPU execution was used because the candidate changes only the CPU gRPC health control plane and makes no numerical/model-path change. The assigned device was visible as one AMD Instinct MI350X under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015, but exercising it would not validate the omitted multimodal architectures or distributed/RL contracts without their implementations and model workloads.
remaining_counterexamples: The original issue's native gRPC multimodal contract remains unmet: the candidate adds no image, audio, or video request fields or conversion path.
Aggregated and encoder-disaggregated native gRPC multimodal coverage remains absent and unverified.
The original issue's RL operability contract remains unmet: no explicit accepting-new-requests/draining/ready-to-serve state is exposed.
No end-to-end lifecycle semantics or adversarial coverage ties pause/drain, weight update, readiness, and resume together.
The health mapping is verified only against a deterministic RuntimeHandle.health_check boolean, not a real model server lifecycle under load or shutdown.
remaining_limitations: This review verifies a partial standard-health implementation, not the complete umbrella feature request.
No model weights, multimodal model architecture, encoder-disaggregated deployment, RL workload, distributed workload, or inference correctness path was exercised.
The host is x86_64 with one visible AMD Instinct MI350X. The candidate has no GPU/native-kernel change; therefore no GPU numerical reference was applicable.

The prepared checkout initially had no importable bundled sglang.srt.rust_extensions._grpc and no Rust toolchain on PATH. Rust 1.92.0 was installed only in /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f2399b3900a4, and both revisions were rebuilt into separate private target directories.
Raw base and candidate build/test outputs are preserved outside the checkout at /job/review-evidence-j-f2399b3900a4.
